venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL came in -6.5% vs target on Saturday ($7,389 net vs $7,902).** Food $365. Comps $102.45. 232 guests / $31.85 GCA. **Another Saturday in the books with World Cup energy** - familiar faces at open and locals coming in intentionally for the Colombia game. MKZ handled prep. Opener cut a little after 9pm; DJ Os.Three (Oscar) did a great job (second strong DJ of the weekend). Closed the door due to humidity. Big shout-out to Keyshawn who came from BOH to support FOH; MOD a great support too. Down a barback but the team came together to keep the space maintained. Smooth close. Kitchen calm. 86 diplomatico, 86 tanqueray. Maintenance: door handle. No-shows not charged. Favorite moment: meeting investor Jason for the first time at last call - he was in all day and never mentioned it, a reminder to treat everyone with respect until the EON. MOD: JK/MKZ. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH beat target +13.9% on Saturday ($12,793 net vs $11,227).** Food $387. Comps $138.40 (1.0%). ~477 guests / $26.82 GCA. **A lovely, steady Saturday** - strong flow of guests right off the bat, a brief lull around 7pm, then consistent volume the rest of the night. Lots of new faces alongside familiar ones - people are still finding out about CC Nash. Kitchen: solid food sales with John-Michael and Kevin holding down BOH and hopping out to the floor. 86 Guinness keg. Maintenance: kitchen door, Well 3 froster still broken. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: three huge D&C fans from Oklahoma to nerd out with over Close Company offerings, plus a few birthdays choosing to celebrate with us. MOD: KK/KE/MD & JMS/KM. Entered by JO.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR came in -1.9% vs base target on Saturday ($21,545.97 net vs $21,957.22); with events, total net was $25,880.97 (+17.9% vs target).** Segments: DC/AM $1,961.93 + D&C PM $19,584.04 + Garden/6A $5,979.45. Food $3,579.80 (base). Comps $856.24 (3.98%). 418 guests (Tock). **A super busy Saturday** - finally cracked 400+ guests on top of a busy Garden shift, with lots of food sales and a heap of investor regulars. AM was fun and busy with a couple IRDs. Garden/6A truly sprinted through the day - late start due to a morning event but averaged over $1,000/hour. **Event:** bridal shower for Alexa Lang (25 guests, 11am-2pm, Garden) - Josh knocked out another big brunch spread plus cake; net event sales $4,335, event food $2,992. Kitchen nice and busy - sold a lot of rabbit agnolotti (Rand & Isaias). Injury/incident: Yes. Break makeup complete; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: everyone in full control of their roles, making 400+ guests look like a cake walk. MOD: Maggie/Josh (AM) / Carey (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **DCEV came in -5.4% vs target on Saturday ($7,901 net vs $8,350).** Food $799 / Beverage $7,060. Comps $164 (gifts + members). 216 guests / $35 GCA. **A mellow start that found its rhythm** - a good run from 7:30-10:30pm, a brief mellow stretch, then steady through the end. The room always felt full with good vibes - lots of twos and first-timers, including Californians who love the MOD's family restaurant (sent off with farewell splashes). Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Rosalie, Shinebox. Door filled nicely before 6:30; many 8pm res arrived early for an easy flip, walk-ins seated with little wait, and a healthy waitlist moved quickly. Welcomed Amy Gionatti (friend of DK) and a number of birthdays. Streets died down after ~11:30 (Pride weekend drawing crowds to dance); a trickle of solos at midnight closed it out smoothly. Menu 18. Glassware: 2 coupes, 2 N&N, 1 DOF, 1 Sidecar vessel. No-shows charged (Sam Lanoff 2@8pm; Mehak Chaudhry 4@10pm couldn't be charged). MOD: Kyler / Alejandro. Entered by Marielle.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA came in -7.8% vs target on Saturday ($10,654 net vs $11,560).** Marquee $8,442; Standing Room $2,048. Food $2,212. Comps $244 (F&F, investors, birthdays, anniversaries, break-ups, DNL, service recovery). 259 guests / $100.51 check avg. **A steady but slower-than-usual Saturday** - started with 110 covers, filled most of the room by 7pm then oddly cleared, hit a lull around 8pm, then refilled. Standing Room was sleepy the first couple hours, filled around 9pm and held until ~11pm. Bryson's first weekend night at the host stand; full kitchen staff most of the night finishing trainings. A strong walk-in push around 10pm, but the team burned and turned to clear the entire waitlist by 11:30pm. SR shut down around midnight with a few last-call tables for an easy close. Lots of familiar faces stopping by to check out the new menu with nothing but good things to say. Kitchen crushed it. No-shows charged. MOD: Joe/Josh/Selenia/Saleh. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC came in -23.4% vs target on Saturday ($8,626.02 net vs $11,263).** Marquee bar $9,082.57 + Garden $597.53. Food $1,150.74. Comps $176.03 (2%); voids $26 (0.3%). 186 guests / $43.57 GCA ($88.93 CA). **A challenging-weather night** - extremely hot in the Garden with almost no traffic the first three hours; after 8pm temps eased and a handful of guests were seated while waiting for Marquee, with a bartender cut at 9:30pm and last call shortly after 10:30. D&C had a steady start with two- and four-tops, but foot traffic stayed lighter than expected due to heat, thunderstorms and the World Cup. Pacing and ticket times stayed steady; servers cut at 10:45pm and 12:30am, all guests out by 2am. Kitchen 11.91% - healthy mix of food, a couple late 86's, big prep day ahead. Injury/incident: Yes. No-shows charged. Recommendation: push Garden in-times to 6pm / open at 7pm given another high-90s day tomorrow. Favorite moment: Grant swapping fresh cold martini glasses for guests. MOD: Marcus/Cory/Josh. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: **Municipal came in -18.6% vs target on Saturday ($13,024 net vs $16,000).** Segments: AM bar $2,827 + PM bar $7,061 + Sun Club $859 + Hot Eye $2,191. Food $4,621. Comps $317. Event $0. 341 guests (127 AM / 214 PM). **A smooth brunch and a steady night** - AM started with a few IRD orders, ran without a second server until 10am and no SA/barback but the team handled it; a 12-top and multiple 8-tops at lunch, busiest 12-1p, then coasted into happy hour. Evening was steady but never completely full; an 11-top no-show was backfilled with late walk-ins (many continuing to Hot Eye), guests gone by 11:15 - an unfortunate amount of glass breakage. Sun Club: Brigid had a great hotel-guest start at noon, pool rocking by 2pm and settled by 3, Kyanne covered a chill rainy evening. Hot Eye: slower start, room picking up ~8:30 with foot traffic to 10, a long lull until ~11:30 then large parties to close; tourist-heavy night with great energy. Maintenance: tear in 43 upholstery; Y peelers. No injury/incident. Favorite moment: Sofia & co. coming in to say goodbye before her voyage West. Entered by Alexis.
